full_judgment:
4. The defendant-respondents contested the suit contending that the suit land was the khas land of the Government. The same was not cultivable land and rightly recorded as "1" 

 8. On the other hand Mr. S.M. Munir, learned Additional Attorney General with Mr. Mohammad Shaheen Mirdha, learned Assistant Attorney General appearing on behalf of the respondents submits that the plaintiff appellants have no title and possession in the suit land. The suit property has been included in khas khatian and it is not cultivatable land, the plaintiffs filed this suit only to grab the Government land. He lastly submits that, it is settled by this Division that if there is merit in any case, generally the delay is condoned and as such the appeal is liable to be dismissed.
